step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Folded-Cascode Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA)
step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a single-stage fully differential folded-cascode OTA with a PMOS input differential pair. It serves as the core operational amplifier for the switched-capacitor integrators in the double-sampling sigma-delta A/D converter.

paper_reference.title: A 250-kHz 94-dB Double-Sampling Modulation A/D Converter With a Modified Noise Transfer Function

paper_reported.value: 108 dB (likely with gain-boosting, not present in this bare netlist)

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm_in * Rout. gm_in ≈ 180uS (at 18uA tail/2). Rout is the parallel combination of PMOS and NMOS cascode output impedances. With L=0.5u, intrinsic gain gm*ro is around 30-40 per transistor. Cascode gain is roughly (gm*ro)^2 ≈ 1000 to 3000.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without gain-boosting amplifiers (which are absent in this netlist), a standard folded cascode in 130nm typically achieves 60-70 dB of gain.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported, but ADC samples at 24/48 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm_in / (2 * pi * C_load). With gm_in = 180uS and C_load = 1pF, GBW = 180e-6 / (2 * 3.14 * 1e-12) ≈ 28.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support a 24 MHz sampling rate, the op-amp GBW must be at least 3-5x the sampling frequency in a switched-capacitor circuit, though this bare sizing yields ~30 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single-stage OTA with 1pF load will have a dominant pole at the output and non-dominant poles at the folding nodes (N0, N2).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Folded cascodes typically have excellent phase margin when driving capacitive loads, as the non-dominant pole is at a very high frequency.

power.description: Total power consumption of the op-amp

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total = I_tail + 2 * I_cascode_branch. With VBP_TAIL=1.0V, I_tail ≈ 36uA. I_cascode ≈ 36uA each. Total current ≈ 108uA. Power = 1.8V * 108uA = 194uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 43 mW reported in the paper is for the entire ADC. A single op-amp of this size consumes a fraction of a milliwatt.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = I_available / C_load. The maximum current available to charge the load is limited by the tail current or the cascode bias current. Here, I_slew ≈ 18uA. SR = 18uA / 1pF = 18 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the bias currents set in the testbench and the 1pF load capacitors.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for measuring DC gain, GBW, phase margin, power, and slew rate of the fully differential folded-cascode OTA. An ideal behavioral CMFB is used to stabilize the output common-mode voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Folded Cascode OTA

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N6 LABEL_NET_0 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 LABEL_NET_1 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 LABEL_NET_2 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 LABEL_NET_3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 LABEL_NET_4 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 LABEL_NET_5 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 LABEL_NET_6 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N0 LABEL_NET_7 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N2 LABEL_NET_8 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N1 LABEL_NET_9 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N5 LABEL_NET_10 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Biases
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.0
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 1.0
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.0
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0.8
VLABEL_NET_9 LABEL_NET_9 0 1.0
VLABEL_NET_10 LABEL_NET_10 0 1.0

* Ideal CMFB for NMOS current sinks (stabilizes output CM to 0.9V)
B_BIAS_N LABEL_NET_3 0 V=0.62+(v(N4)+v(N6)-1.8)*10
B_BIAS_N2 LABEL_NET_5 0 V=0.62+(v(N4)+v(N6)-1.8)*10

* Inputs (AC for frequency response, Pulse for slew rate)
V_INM LABEL_NET_7 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.9 0.4 10n 1n 1n 2u 4u)
V_INP LABEL_NET_8 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.9 1.4 10n 1n 1n 2u 4u)

* Load Capacitors
CL1 N4 0 1p
CL2 N6 0 1p

.control
  * DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1 1G
  let vout_diff = v(N6) - v(N4)
  let gain_db = 20*log10(mag(vout_diff))
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(vout_diff)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_margin find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis for Slew Rate
  tran 0.1n 100n
  let vout_diff_tran = v(N6) - v(N4)
  meas tran t_rise trig vout_diff_tran val=0.5 rise=1 targ vout_diff_tran val=1.5 rise=1
  let sr_v_us = 1.0 / t_rise / 1e6
  print sr_v_us
  
  quit
.endc
